analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive trading day. RSI has entered oversold territory (32.5), continuing its decline from 36.8 five days ago. MACD histogram has worsened from -0.0031 to -0.0067, indicating bearish convergence. ADX is at 19.4, showing no trend formation, with -DI (30.2) exceeding +DI (18.1), suggesting downward pressure dominance. The 5-day low ($1.15) matches the 20-day low ($1.15), and the 5-day high ($1.34) is lower than the 20-day high ($1.40), indicating a potential Lower High pattern. The current price ($1.17) is near the lower Bollinger Band ($1.18). Weekly RSI is 42.2 and weekly MACD histogram is 0.0091, showing weak trend reversal signals compared to the daily chart. Considering stop loss of 1.0-4.0 times ATR ($0.05) and a risk-reward ratio of 1.5 or higher, there is no suitable entry point for a buy.
